title: CalCOFI oxygen on the 26.5 isopycnal in 2007-2025 was lower than in any 19-year window since 1950; trend, 18.6-year-cycle and lagged PDO/NPGO fits to 1950-2006 did not forecast it
abstract: Question: is the 2007-2025 oxygen low on sigma0 = 26.5 in the southern California Current new, or one phase of a natural cycle such as the 18.6-year lunar nodal cycle? Approach: we extended the isopycnal record to 1950 with Winkler bottle oxygen from the CalCOFI bottle database (to 2021-05) and preliminary CTD-file bottle rows (to 2025-04). We used 45 stations sampled before and after 1984 (9,786 casts, 66 annual means). Anomalies are from the 1950-2006 station x season means. We fitted forecasts to 1950-2006 and tested them on 2007-2025. Results: the 2007-2025 mean anomaly was -14.6 umol/kg (95% interval -15.9 to -13.5). The 1950-1983 mean was 0.0, and the lowest 19-year mean before 2007 was -2.1. In 18 of 19 test years, oxygen was below the lowest annual value before 2000 (-11.3 in 1957). The 1950-2006 trend was 0.00 (-0.22 to +0.22) umol/kg per year. Thus the 1984-2006 decline started from a high state. An 18.6-year cycle explained 2.5% of the detrended variance (red-noise p = 0.79), and no period from 10 to 40 years was above red noise. Trend, trend + 18.6-year cycle, best-cycle, lagged PDO and lagged NPGO forecasts had test RMSE 14.6-20.2; persistence of the 2002-2006 level had 3.7. The oxygen-salinity correlation was -0.93 in 1984-2006 but -0.32 in 1950-1983 and -0.08 after 2006. From 1950-1966 to 2008-2025, AOU rose by 11.0 umol/kg, solubility fell by 0.7, and the isopycnal was 17 m deeper. The results hold in nine station and sampling checks and in a fixed-effects index. Limitations: 1969-1983 sampling is sparse; the record has little power for a small 20-year cycle; we did not test early Winkler calibration; post-2021 data are preliminary; the design knew the 1984-2025 result; AOU cannot separate ventilation from respiration.

display.caption: Top: annual (black) and cruise-mean (gray) oxygen anomalies on sigma0 = 26.5 at 45 long-record CalCOFI stations, 1950-2025, with era means (dotted) and 2007-2025 forecasts fitted to 1950-2006. Only the held 2002-2006 level is near the observations. Bottom: AOU and oxygen-solubility anomalies.
Annual oxygen against salinity anomaly on sigma0 = 26.5 for 1950-1983, 1984-2006 and 2007-2025. The strong 1984-2006 relation (dashed) does not hold before 1984 or after 2006.

(a) Fraction of detrended variance explained by a sinusoid of each period, with the AR(1) red-noise 95% level for the maximum and the 18.6-year nodal period. (b) For nine station and sampling checks: 2007-2025 mean, lowest 19-year mean before 2007, and 1950-1983 mean.
